title: Consumer 3D printer
whyItFails: Limited use cases. Most people don't need custom parts. Usability. Printing is fiddly. Price competition. Cheap printers commoditise the market.
whatWouldChange: Remains hobbyist; AI-generated designs might help.

attempts.outcome: Acquired by Stratasys, later merged into UltiMaker
attempts.notes: Shifted from consumers to professional and education markets in 2017 with layoffs of over 30%.

attempts.outcome: Most Kickstarter backers never received a printer
attempts.notes: Raised $1.5 million on Kickstarter for the Buccaneer printer.

reasons.detail: Limited use cases: Most people don't need custom parts.
Price competition: Cheap printers commoditise the market.
